cross_case_diversity_review.domain_diversity: Six substantively different domains: software release operations, community cold-chain routing, watershed field logistics, manufacturing qualification, event accessibility, and publishing rights review.
cross_case_diversity_review.decision_rule_diversity: The set includes a categorical-plus-threshold conjunction, sequential eligibility and route-time tiebreak, computed-reserve conjunction, corrected-mean plus interval-containment plus range conjunction, ceiling-and-residual-capacity arithmetic, and count-plus-privacy predicate logic.
cross_case_diversity_review.turn_structure_diversity: Histories range from 17 to 55 messages; three state the derived decision and repair it in W, while three deliberately leave it unstated and need no downstream target repair. Rules and load-bearing inputs also appear at different points and in different orders.
cross_case_diversity_review.distractor_diversity: Distractors span timestamp provenance, matched-test protocol, preliminary sensor readings, maintenance and traceability records, optional arrival routing, and editorial layout/copyediting. Nonfocal controls likewise vary across retention duration, weekday, radio channel, cabinet mapping, appointment time, and vendor identity.
cross_case_diversity_review.probe_diversity: All probes request a short categorical answer, as required by the assay, but they differ in whether they cue the operative inputs, refer to an already selected result, or ask for application of an unstated rule.

fill_in_the_nouns_risk.assessment: The cases share a deliberately explicit audit/planning register and binary mandatory-rule discipline, but they are not one scaffold with nouns replaced. Their computations, evidence topology, number and placement of changed messages, explicit-versus-unstated handling, history length, distractor chains, nonfocal controls, and retained-tail tasks differ materially.
fill_in_the_nouns_risk.residual_limitation: The common didactic register and repeated assistant restatement of mandatory rules reduce ecological breadth. This is a bounded external-validity limitation, not a paired-validity failure or a shared fill-in-the-nouns template.
